credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach (Crystal-rule pilot), hand-pixelled in tools/art/pilot_crystal/oak.py. Drawn under the pilot's palette and animation rules; no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Intro: the two branches coil down, flex up, pump twice and brace (lead leaf thrust out level like a shield). Trunk, cap and roots are pixel-identical. Learned: with the cap brown in index 1 the sprite went dark; more leaf mass (a bigger lead leaf, a low back leaf) keeps index 2 green as the body colour. Sport: 'Concordia' golden oak. Quercus robur 'Concordia' (Van Geert, Ghent, 1843): butter-yellow leaves, gold-green acorns (indexes 1-2 only).
